title: Pearson schema metadata block
description: The governance metadata block every schema registered in Apicurio must carry, declared in the schema BODY. This file is the machine-readable statement of the contract that app/services/metadata_validator.py enforces at runtime: checks 3-8 map one-to-one onto the constraints below. The body is authoritative; the same values are mirrored into Apicurio v3 `labels` as a derived query index (ADR-0001), and a disagreement between the two is reported as the `properties_mismatch` rule rather than silently reconciled. Keep this file and the validator in step — if they diverge, the validator is what actually runs.

metadata.description: Validator check 3 (`metadata_block_missing`): a top-level `metadata` object must be present.

owner.description: Validator check 4 (`owner_missing`, `owner_unresolved`): `service` must be present and resolve to an ACTIVE CMDB configuration item.

service.description: CMDB CI ID of the owning service.

email.description: Distribution list, not an individual — ownership outlives people.

domain.description: Validator check 5 (`domain_missing`, `domain_mismatch`): must equal the first dot-segment of the artifactId, so the registry coordinate and the declared domain cannot drift apart.

piiFields.description: Validator check 8: each entry must resolve to a real field in the schema body — `fields[].name` for Avro, a `properties` key for JSON Schema — and the WHOLE dotted path is followed, not just its first segment, so a typo below the top level is caught (`pii_field_not_found`). A leading `$.` is stripped first, and an array is TRANSPARENT: name the field directly (`contributors.contributorGivenName`), because a subscript picks an element and every element has the same fields — `contributors[].x` and `contributors[0].x` are accepted and mean the same thing. An entry that names no field at all (an empty string, '$.' or '...') is rejected as `pii_field_malformed` rather than passing silently. Absent or empty means no PII is declared — which is a claim, not an absence of obligation.

$comment: Checks 1 (`schema_type_unsupported`) and 2 (`body_unparseable`) are not expressible here: they gate on the Apicurio artifact type and on the body being parseable JSON at all, both of which precede any schema-level validation. Check 1 no longer means Avro-only (UIFPE-597): AVRO and JSON bodies both run every constraint below, and a gold attribute mapping is detected by body shape and validated against standards/gold-attribute-mapping.schema.json instead, since its contract never asked it to carry a metadata block. PROTOBUF, GRAPHQL, XSD, OPENAPI and ASYNCAPI still short-circuit before these constraints are ever applied. See ../../ARCHITECTURE.md.
